title: Disaster Management Act, 2005
edition: 2005; subsequently amended, including the Disaster Management (Amendment) Act, 2025
sourceNote: Official (Ministry of Home Affairs). The NDM India repository hosts the Disaster Management Act, 2005 and separately records the 2025 amendment. The 2025 amendment should be retained as a separate amending instrument rather than treating this 2005 PDF as a fully consolidated current Act.

title: State Disaster Response Fund / National Disaster Response Fund — Items and Norms of Assistance
titleHi: राज्य आपदा मोचन निधि / राष्ट्रीय आपदा मोचन निधि — सहायता की मदें एवं मानदंड
edition: Current MHA SDRF/NDRF framework; 15th Finance Commission award period 2021-22 to 2025-26
sourceNote: Official (Ministry of Home Affairs). The official response-fund repository identifies SDRF as the primary State fund and NDRF as supplementary assistance for disasters of severe nature. The linked official document contains the 2021-22 to 2025-26 funding framework.

title: Standard Operating Procedure for DBT Payments
titleHi: डीबीटी भुगतान हेतु मानक संचालन प्रक्रिया
sourceNote: Official (DBT Mission). The official DBT Bharat repository identifies this as the Standard Operating Procedure for DBT Payments and describes the beneficiary identification, validation, payment-file and payment-processing workflow.

title: Guidelines for State DBT Cell
sourceNote: Official (DBT Mission). The document defines the State DBT Cell's coordination, technical, implementation and monitoring role between Central Ministries, State departments and district/block/panchayat administration.
